answer: Cloning identities requires replaying the full voyage and recomputing the sonnet hash at real compute cost, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Each agent stakes a unique on-chain relic earned only by completing a verified voyage, and voting power derives from a sonnet-seeded proof-of-work puzzle tied to that relic's history. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
